topic: Getting used-car promises in writing vs trusting "as is" (Dane vs Maud)

scenes.narration: A verbal promise meant nothing once the as is car blew its engine. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom beside a smoking used car stamped AS IS, comic burst banner reads NO WARRANTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dane and Maud each buy the same used car from a slick lot.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man dane and woman maud on a used car lot, a salesman gesturing, a price sign beside the car, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The salesman swears the engine and transmission are perfectly solid.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a smiling salesman pointing at a used car, comic banner reads RUNS PERFECT TRUST ME, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Maud trusts the handshake and signs an as is bill of sale.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman maud signing a paper stamped SOLD AS IS, a handshake with the salesman, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She drives off with zero promises written anywhere on paper.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman maud driving away happy, an empty contract folder labeled NO WARRANTY beside her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dane asks the dealer to put every promise into the contract.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man dane at a desk pointing to a contract, a line labeled WRITTEN GUARANTEE, the salesman hesitating, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He pays a mechanic to inspect the car before he signs.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a mechanic under the hood of a car with a clipboard labeled INSPECTION REPORT, man dane watching, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dane gets a thirty day written guarantee on the engine.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man dane holding a signed contract with a highlighted line reading THIRTY DAY ENGINE GUARANTEE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Maud's engine dies in two weeks and the dealer refuses everything.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman maud beside a smoking broken down car, a dealer pointing at a sign stamped AS IS NO REFUNDS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She loses in court because nothing was ever written down.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman maud shocked in a courtroom holding only a blank as is receipt, a gavel striking, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dane's written guarantee forces a free engine repair at the dealer.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man dane smiling as mechanics fix his car, an invoice stamped COVERED ZERO OWED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Get every car promise in writing and inspect before you sign. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel in the courtroom, a clipboard reads GET IT IN WRITING, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
